blocks.zh: 附錄 G1–G2：參考文獻與名詞解釋
blocks.en: Appendices G1-G2: References and Glossary

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives — 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Identify the key regulatory references cited in GAMP 5 (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ICH Q9/Q10) and understand why each is foundational to computerized system validation. / 識別 GAMP 5 引用的核心法規文件，理解各自在電腦化系統驗證中的基礎地位。
blocks.en: Identify the key regulatory references cited in GAMP 5 (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ICH Q9/Q10) and understand why each is foundational to computerized system validation.

blocks.zh: Distinguish between "validation," "qualification," and "verification" as defined in the GAMP 5 glossary, and apply the correct term in validation documentation. / 區辨 GAMP 5 詞彙表中「驗證」、「確效」與「查核」三個術語的精確定義，並在驗證文件中正確使用。
blocks.en: Distinguish between "validation," "qualification," and "verification" as defined in the GAMP 5 glossary, and apply the correct term in validation documentation.

blocks.zh: Explain the roles of "regulated company," "supplier," "system owner," and "process owner," and describe how responsibilities differ. / 說明受管制公司、供應商、系統擁有者及流程擁有者的角色分工與責任差異。
blocks.en: Explain the roles of "regulated company," "supplier," "system owner," and "process owner," and describe how responsibilities differ.

blocks.zh: Use the GAMP 5 glossary and reference list to correctly cite standards and define key terms during regulatory inspections or validation document preparation. / 在法規查核或驗證文件撰寫時，能正確引用 GAMP 5 標準並定義關鍵術語。
blocks.en: Use the GAMP 5 glossary and reference list to correctly cite standards and define key terms during regulatory inspections or validation document preparation.

blocks.zh: Appendix G1 — References / 附錄 G1：參考文獻
blocks.en: Appendix G1 — References

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 參考文獻導讀
blocks.en: Commentary — Guide to the References

blocks.zh: 核心法規文件解析 — 為什麼要引用這些標準？
blocks.en: Core Regulatory Documents — Why Cite These Standards?

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 第二版的附錄 G1 列出超過 100 份引用文件。對 CDMO 實務工作者來說，最重要的是以下三個法規核心：
blocks.en: Appendix G1 of GAMP 5 Second Edition lists more than 100 referenced documents. For CDMO practitioners, the three most important regulatory cornerstones are the following:

blocks.zh:
21 CFR Part 11（美國 FDA）
管轄範圍：電子記錄 (Electronic Records) 與電子簽章 (Electronic Signatures)。核心要求：電子記錄必須可信、可靠、等同於紙本記錄，且電子簽章具法律效力。
常見誤解：Part 11 不是要求「所有系統必須有電子簽章」，而是當你選擇使用電子記錄時，必須符合這些要求。
blocks.en:
21 CFR Part 11 (US FDA)
Scope: electronic records and electronic signatures. Core requirement: electronic records must be trustworthy, reliable, and equivalent to paper records, and electronic signatures must carry legal weight.
Common misunderstanding: Part 11 does not require "every system to have electronic signatures"; rather, when you choose to use electronic records, you must meet these requirements.

blocks.zh:
EU GMP Annex 11（歐盟）
管轄範圍：GMP 範圍內的電腦化系統。與 21 CFR Part 11 的關鍵差異：Annex 11 涵蓋更廣的系統生命週期概念，包括供應商評估、驗收測試、定期回顧 (Periodic Review)，以及資料完整性要求。
重點：Annex 11 在某些方面比 21 CFR Part 11 要求更嚴格，例如明確要求供應商稽核。
blocks.en:
EU GMP Annex 11 (European Union)
Scope: computerized systems within the GMP scope. Key difference from 21 CFR Part 11: Annex 11 covers a broader system life cycle concept, including supplier assessment, acceptance testing, periodic review, and data integrity requirements.
Key point: in some respects Annex 11 is stricter than 21 CFR Part 11, for example in explicitly requiring supplier audits.

blocks.zh:
ICH Q9（品質風險管理）
GAMP 5 風險導向方法的科學基礎。ICH Q9 提供了「危害」、「風險」、「嚴重性」、「可偵測性」等詞彙的官方定義，GAMP 5 詞彙表直接引用這些定義。
重要性：當你在驗證文件中進行風險評估時，你的方法論必須能對應到 ICH Q9 的框架。
blocks.en:
ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management)
The scientific basis of the GAMP 5 risk-based approach. ICH Q9 provides the official definitions of terms such as "harm," "risk," "severity," and "detectability," and the GAMP 5 glossary cites these definitions directly.
Why it matters: when you perform risk assessments in validation documents, your methodology must map to the ICH Q9 framework.

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 — 製藥品質系統的整體框架
blocks.en: ICH Q10 — The Overall Framework for the Pharmaceutical Quality System

blocks.zh: ICH Q10（製藥品質系統）與 ICH Q9 相輔相成，Q10 描述了在整個產品生命週期中維持品質系統的要求，GAMP 5 的 CSV 工作必須在 Q10 框架下運作。
blocks.en: ICH Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System) complements ICH Q9. Q10 describes the requirements for maintaining a quality system throughout the product life cycle, and CSV work under GAMP 5 must operate within the Q10 framework.

blocks.zh: ASTM E2500-20 同樣重要：它提供了「Verification（查核）」作為 CSV 替代路徑的標準依據，是 ISPE Vol. 5 C&Q 指南的重要基礎。
blocks.en: ASTM E2500-20 is equally important: it provides the standard basis for "Verification" as an alternative route to CSV, and is an important foundation of the ISPE Vol. 5 C&Q Guide.

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 引用文件的使用原則
blocks.en: Principles for Using the GAMP 5 References

blocks.zh: 當文件引用「ICH Q9 [14]」這樣的格式時，方括號內的數字就是 G1 附錄中的編號。
blocks.en: When a document cites "ICH Q9 [14]," the number in square brackets is the reference number in Appendix G1.

blocks.zh: 在您自己的驗證文件中引用 GAMP 5 時，正確格式為：「ISPE GAMP 5 Second Edition, 2022, www.ispe.org」
blocks.en: When citing GAMP 5 in your own validation documents, the correct format is: "ISPE GAMP 5 Second Edition, 2022, www.ispe.org".

blocks.zh: 稽核員可能要求您證明您了解所引用文件的具體要求，不只是列在參考文獻中而已。
blocks.en: Auditors may ask you to demonstrate that you understand the specific requirements of the documents you cite, not merely that they are listed in the references.

blocks.zh: PIC/S PI 011-3（電腦化系統指南）適用於歐盟 GMP 稽核，是 GAMP 5 之外的重要補充。
blocks.en: PIC/S PI 011-3 (Guidance on computerized systems) applies to EU GMP inspections and is an important supplement to GAMP 5.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 — 在驗證文件中正確引用法規
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application — Citing Regulations Correctly in Validation Documents

blocks.zh: 驗證主計畫 (VMP) 中的法規依據章節：
blocks.en: Regulatory basis section of the Validation Master Plan (VMP):

blocks.zh: 列出適用的所有法規：21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, ICH Q9, ICH Q10
blocks.en: List all applicable regulations: 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, ICH Q9, ICH Q10

blocks.zh: 說明各法規的適用市場（美國、歐盟、日本等）
blocks.en: State the market each regulation applies to (US, EU, Japan, etc.)

blocks.zh: 引用 GAMP 5 作為方法論指導依據
blocks.en: Cite GAMP 5 as the methodological guidance

blocks.zh: 風險評估文件中：
blocks.en: In risk assessment documents:

blocks.zh: 明確聲明風險評估方法依據 ICH Q9 原則
blocks.en: State explicitly that the risk assessment method is based on ICH Q9 principles

blocks.zh: 定義使用的術語（Harm, Hazard, Risk, Severity, Detectability）
blocks.en: Define the terms used (Harm, Hazard, Risk, Severity, Detectability)

blocks.zh:
常見稽核問題：
「您的 CSV 方法是基於哪個指南？」— 回答：GAMP 5 2nd Edition (2022), supported by EU GMP Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11.
blocks.en:
Common audit question:
"Which guideline is your CSV approach based on?" — Answer: GAMP 5 2nd Edition (2022), supported by EU GMP Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 vs. EU Annex 11 — 相同但不相同
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11 vs. EU Annex 11 — Similar but Not the Same

blocks.zh: 同時銷售 FDA 和 EU 市場的 CDMO，必須同時符合兩套要求，取較嚴格者為準。
blocks.en: A CDMO selling to both the FDA and EU markets must comply with both sets of requirements, applying the stricter one where they differ.

blocks.zh: Appendix G2, Section 53.1 — Acronyms & Abbreviations / 縮寫對照表
blocks.en: Appendix G2, Section 53.1 — Acronyms & Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 20 個最重要的 GAMP 5 縮寫
blocks.en: Commentary — The 20 Most Important GAMP 5 Acronyms

blocks.zh: 稽核員常問的縮寫問題
blocks.en: Acronym Questions Auditors Often Ask

blocks.zh: 在 FDA 或 EU 稽查時，稽核員可能會隨機詢問縮寫含義，以確認您的 CSV 知識基礎：
blocks.en: During an FDA or EU inspection, auditors may ask at random what an acronym means, to confirm your CSV knowledge base:

blocks.zh: "What is COTS software under GAMP 5?" — 商業現成軟體，已有廣泛商業用戶驗證其適用性，可簡化驗證策略。
blocks.en: "What is COTS software under GAMP 5?" — Commercial off-the-shelf software, whose suitability has been proven by a broad base of commercial users, which can simplify the validation strategy.

blocks.zh: "What is the difference between URS and FS?" — URS 描述使用者業務需求；FS 描述系統如何實現這些需求。
blocks.en: "What is the difference between URS and FS?" — The URS describes the users' business requirements; the FS describes how the system fulfils those requirements.

blocks.zh: "What does GxP cover?" — GMP, GLP, GCP, GDP, GVP 等所有適用法規規範的總稱。
blocks.en: "What does GxP cover?" — A collective term for all applicable regulatory standards, including GMP, GLP, GCP, GDP, and GVP.

blocks.zh: "What is ALCOA+?" — 資料完整性的九項原則：可歸屬、易讀、同步、原始、準確、完整、一致、持久、可取用。
blocks.en: "What is ALCOA+?" — The nine principles of data integrity: attributable, legible, contemporaneous, original, accurate, complete, consistent, enduring, and available.

blocks.zh: CSA vs. CSV — 新舊方法的關鍵差異
blocks.en: CSA vs. CSV — Key Differences Between the New and Old Approaches

blocks.zh: FDA 在 2022 年推出 CSA（Computer Software Assurance）指南草案，作為傳統 CSV 的補充方向：
blocks.en: In 2022 the FDA issued the draft Computer Software Assurance (CSA) guidance as a complementary direction to traditional CSV:

blocks.zh: CSV：重視文件完整性，IQ/OQ/PQ 三階段，測試腳本詳盡
blocks.en: CSV: emphasizes documentation completeness, the three IQ/OQ/PQ stages, and detailed test scripts

blocks.zh: CSA：強調「關鍵思維」(critical thinking)，風險導向決定測試範圍，減少不必要文件
blocks.en: CSA: emphasizes critical thinking, risk-based determination of testing scope, and less unnecessary documentation

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 2nd Edition 同時支援兩種方法，讓受管制公司依風險選擇適合的方式。
blocks.en: GAMP 5 2nd Edition supports both approaches, allowing regulated companies to choose the one that suits them according to risk.

blocks.zh: Appendix G2, Section 53.2 — Definitions / 名詞定義
blocks.en: Appendix G2, Section 53.2 — Definitions

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 重要定義精析（上半段）
blocks.en: Commentary — Key Definitions Explained (Part 1)

blocks.zh: 三個最容易混淆的術語辨析
blocks.en: Distinguishing the Three Most Easily Confused Terms

blocks.zh: Validation（驗證）vs. Qualification（確效）vs. Verification（查核）
blocks.en: Validation vs. Qualification vs. Verification

blocks.zh: 這三個詞在日常中文習慣上常被混用，但在 GAMP 5 中有精確的層次關係：
blocks.en: In everyday usage these three terms are often used interchangeably, but GAMP 5 gives them a precise hierarchical relationship:

blocks.zh: Verification（查核）：ASTM E2500 使用的上位概念，「確認製造系統適合預定用途的系統性方法」，是一個包含所有確認方式的傘狀術語。
blocks.en: Verification: the umbrella concept used by ASTM E2500, "a systematic approach to verify that manufacturing systems are fit for intended use"; it covers all means of confirmation.

blocks.zh: Validation（驗證）：GAMP 5 對 Computerized System Validation 的定義，強調「達成並維持 GxP 合規及適合預定用途」，涵蓋生命週期全程。
blocks.en: Validation: GAMP 5's definition for Computerized System Validation, emphasizing "achieving and maintaining GxP compliance and fitness for intended use" across the entire life cycle.

blocks.zh: Qualification（確效）：特指 IQ/OQ/PQ 等設備或系統的逐階確認活動，是 Validation 的組成部分之一。
blocks.en: Qualification: specifically the stage-by-stage confirmation activities such as IQ/OQ/PQ for equipment or systems; it is one component of Validation.

blocks.zh: 簡言之：Verification ⊇ Validation ⊇ Qualification（範圍由大到小）
blocks.en: In short: Verification ⊇ Validation ⊇ Qualification (from broadest to narrowest scope)

blocks.zh: Computerized System 的正式定義 — 比你想的更廣
blocks.en: The Formal Definition of Computerized System — Broader Than You Think

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 明確定義電腦化系統包括：硬體 + 軟體 + 網路元件 + 受控功能 + 相關文件。
blocks.en: GAMP 5 explicitly defines a computerized system as comprising hardware + software + network components + controlled functions + associated documentation.

blocks.zh: 這意味著一台簡單的 PLC 控制器（含其程序邏輯）也算是電腦化系統，需要適當的驗證方法。CDMO 常見的電腦化系統包括：MES、LIMS、EDMS、ERP、DCS/PLC、稱量系統等。
blocks.en: This means even a simple PLC controller (including its program logic) is a computerized system and needs an appropriate validation approach. Computerized systems commonly found at a CDMO include MES, LIMS, EDMS, ERP, DCS/PLC, weighing systems, and others.

blocks.zh: GxP 涵蓋的法規範圍 — 一圖讀懂
blocks.en: The Regulatory Scope of GxP — Understood at a Glance

blocks.zh: CDMO 主要適用 GMP，但若有承接臨床試驗用藥生產，需同時考慮 GCP 對資料完整性的要求。
blocks.en: A CDMO is mainly subject to GMP, but if it manufactures investigational medicinal products for clinical trials, it must also consider GCP requirements for data integrity.

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 來源術語 — 稽核員最喜歡問的
blocks.en: Terms Sourced from ICH Q9 — Auditors' Favorites

blocks.zh: GAMP 5 詞彙表中有大量術語直接引用 ICH Q9。稽核員常問：
blocks.en: The GAMP 5 glossary cites many terms directly from ICH Q9. Auditors often ask:

blocks.zh: Harm（危害）：對健康的損害，包括產品品質或供應可用性損失所造成的損害。
blocks.en: Harm: damage to health, including the damage that can occur from loss of product quality or availability.

blocks.zh: Hazard（危險源）：傷害的潛在來源（不等同於 Harm）。
blocks.en: Hazard: the potential source of harm (not the same as Harm).

blocks.zh: Risk = Probability × Severity：發生危害的機率乘以嚴重程度的組合。
blocks.en: Risk = Probability × Severity: the combination of the probability of occurrence of harm and the severity of that harm.

blocks.zh: Detectability（可偵測性）：辨識危險源存在的能力（有助於降低整體風險評分）。
blocks.en: Detectability: the ability to discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of a hazard (helps lower the overall risk score).

blocks.zh: COTS 軟體 — 用超市食品打比方
blocks.en: COTS Software — A Supermarket Food Analogy

blocks.zh: COTS（商業現成軟體）就像超市販售的現成食品：製造商（供應商）已經大規模生產並通過市場驗證，你（受管制公司）不需要從零建立，但你需要確認它適合你的具體需求（URS），並在你的環境中正確組態。
blocks.en: COTS (commercial off-the-shelf software) is like ready-made food sold in a supermarket: the manufacturer (supplier) has already produced it at scale and it has been proven in the market. You (the regulated company) do not need to build it from scratch, but you do need to confirm that it fits your specific needs (URS) and configure it correctly in your environment.

blocks.zh: 相反地，自定義開發軟體（Category 5）就像自己從頭烹調，需要完整的開發生命週期管控。
blocks.en: By contrast, custom-developed software (Category 5) is like cooking from scratch: it requires full development life cycle control.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 重要定義精析（下半段）
blocks.en: Commentary — Key Definitions Explained (Part 2)

blocks.zh: Periodic Review（定期回顧）— 常被忽略的要求
blocks.en: Periodic Review — A Frequently Overlooked Requirement

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 11 明確要求對電腦化系統進行定期回顧，GAMP 5 詞彙表也提供了正式定義：
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 11 explicitly requires periodic review of computerized systems, and the GAMP 5 glossary also provides a formal definition:

blocks.zh: 評估文件、程序、記錄和系統效能
blocks.en: Evaluate documentation, procedures, records, and system performance

blocks.zh: 確認系統仍處於「已驗證狀態」(validated state)
blocks.en: Confirm the system remains in a validated state

blocks.zh: 回顧頻率依系統的複雜性、關鍵性和變更頻率而定
blocks.en: Review frequency depends on the system's complexity, criticality, and frequency of change

blocks.zh: 實務建議：建立 Periodic Review SOP，每 1-3 年執行一次，並記錄結果。稽核時若無此記錄，EU 查核員會開立缺失。
blocks.en: Practical advice: establish a Periodic Review SOP, perform reviews every 1-3 years, and record the results. If you cannot produce these records during an inspection, EU inspectors will issue a deficiency.

blocks.zh: 如何在查核中引用詞彙表 — 實戰技巧
blocks.en: How to Cite the Glossary During Inspections — Practical Tips

blocks.zh: 當稽核員要求定義術語時，標準回應策略：
blocks.en: When an auditor asks you to define a term, the standard response strategy is:

blocks.zh: 第一層：引用 GAMP 5 或其引用來源（如 ICH Q9）的官方定義
blocks.en: Layer 1: Cite the official definition from GAMP 5 or its source reference (such as ICH Q9)

blocks.zh: 第二層：解釋該定義如何應用於你的系統或流程
blocks.en: Layer 2: Explain how that definition applies to your system or process

blocks.zh: 第三層：提供你的 SOP 或驗證文件中如何體現該定義
blocks.en: Layer 3: Show where your SOPs or validation documents reflect that definition

blocks.zh:
例如被問到「什麼是 GxP Compliance？」：
「依據 GAMP 5 定義，GxP Compliance 是指符合所有適用的藥品及生命科學法規要求。對我們公司而言，主要適用的法規包括 FDA 21 CFR Parts 211 和 11，以及 EU GMP Annex 11，我們的 VMP 中有詳細說明。」
blocks.en:
For example, when asked "What is GxP Compliance?":
"According to the GAMP 5 definition, GxP Compliance means meeting all applicable pharmaceutical and life science regulatory requirements. For our company, the main applicable regulations include FDA 21 CFR Parts 211 and 11 and EU GMP Annex 11, as detailed in our VMP."

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用提示 — 角色責任的實務安排
blocks.en: CDMO Application Tip — Practical Arrangement of Role Responsibilities

blocks.zh: 典型 CDMO 電腦化系統責任矩陣：
blocks.en: Typical CDMO computerized system responsibility matrix:

blocks.zh: EDMS (文件管理系統)：System Owner = IT；Process Owner = QA Manager
blocks.en: EDMS (Document Management System): System Owner = IT; Process Owner = QA Manager

blocks.zh: 環境監控系統 (EMS)：System Owner = Engineering；Process Owner = QA Manager
blocks.en: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS): System Owner = Engineering; Process Owner = QA Manager

blocks.zh: 建立此矩陣並記錄在 VMP 或系統清單中，是 EU Annex 11 稽核的基本要求。Process Owner 必須實際理解系統功能，而非僅掛名簽署。
blocks.en: Establishing this matrix and recording it in the VMP or system inventory is a basic expectation in EU Annex 11 inspections. The Process Owner must genuinely understand the system's functions, not merely sign in name only.

blocks.zh: System Owner vs. Process Owner — 責任分界清單
blocks.en: System Owner vs. Process Owner — Responsibility Boundary Checklist

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：一個 LIMS 系統，IT 部門是 System Owner，QC 主管是 Process Owner。資料完整性的責任在 QC 主管，而非 IT。
blocks.en: CDMO practice: for a LIMS, the IT department is the System Owner and the QC head is the Process Owner. Responsibility for data integrity lies with the QC head, not IT.

blocks.zh: Section Summary — 本節重點總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 附錄 G1 的 106 份引用文件構成了 GAMP 5 知識體系的法規地基；附錄 G2 的詞彙表則確保所有利害關係人（受管制公司、供應商、稽核員）對相同術語有一致的理解。對 CDMO 而言，精通這些定義是通過 FDA 和 EU 稽查的必要基礎，也是在驗證文件中正確使用專業術語的前提。
blocks.en: The 106 referenced documents in Appendix G1 form the regulatory foundation of the GAMP 5 body of knowledge, while the glossary in Appendix G2 ensures that all stakeholders (regulated companies, suppliers, auditors) share a consistent understanding of the same terms. For a CDMO, mastering these definitions is essential to passing FDA and EU inspections and a prerequisite for using technical terminology correctly in validation documents.
